notes.title: 第2回「グニャリンピック」1/11 （土）開催決定！上位入賞者には豪華賞品をプレゼント
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42421569/f726081d957a5687d980d46ec848db47c9c57bfd.png[/img]

[h3]『グーニャモンスター』のオンラインeスポーツ大会「グニャリンピック」の第2回大会を2025年1月11日（土）に開催いたします。本大会へのエントリーは、2024年12月2日（月）まで受付中です。第2回大会は参加賞の用意もあるため、奮ってご応募ください！[/h3]

[h3]◆大会概要[/h3]

■イベントタイトル：グニャリンピック
■日時：2025年1月11日（土）15:00~20:00
※進行状況により終了時間は前後する可能性があります
■会場：オンライン開催
■主催：株式会社MUTAN

■募集対象者（参加資格）：
・「グーニャモンスター」をお持ちの方※プラットフォーム不問
・Discordアカウントをお持ちの方
※詳しくはグーニャモンスター公式X（ https://twitter.com/GoonyaJP ）をご確認ください。

■大会形式：「プライベートマッチ」によるトーナメント

■賞品：
1位：Amazonギフト券30,000円分＋サイン色紙＋シリアルナンバー入キャップ＋オリジナルTシャツ

notes.title: 【Announcing Update Version 2.3.0】
notes.content:
[h3]The update to version 2.3.0 will be on September/8 (JST 12:00) for balance adjustment and bug fixes.[/h3]

The details of the update are as follows:

　・Added "GO ON YA WAY/Alice" to the BGM settings.

[h3]◆ Gameplay Rebalance[/h3]
【Battle Balance】
　▼Buster
　　・Adjusted the "power" of "Soul Healer" slightly higher.
　　・Adjusted the "healing power" of "Soul Healer" slightly higher.
　▼Monster
　　・Set a cooldown time for message usage.
　　・When the "Punch" hits the Buster, if the damage exceeds the remaining HP of the Buster, it has been changed to "Predation".
　　・Changed the activation count of "Minotaur's" "Rush Attack" from 3 times to 1 time.
　　・Reduced the homing range of "Minotaur's" "Rush Attack".
　　・Shortened the "cooldown" of the "Minotaur's" skill.

[h3]◆ System[/h3]
　・Adjusted to decrease the rating reduction value.
　・Increased the number of "Soul Gems" obtained from the Soul Gacha. ※There are no changes to the probabilities.
　・Changed to be able to skip the episode ending event.
　・Added a page about the area where damage occurs around the Soul Pot in the "How to Play" section.

[h3]◆ Bug Fixes[/h3]
　・Fixed a bug where the trophy "First Bite" could not be acquired.
　・Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: 【Announcing Update Version 2.2.0】
notes.content:
[h3]The update to version 2.2.0 will be on July/26 (JST 12:00) for balance adjustment and bug fixes.[/h3]

This time, as a measure against the phenomenon where game balance is skewed by certain strategies, we have implemented an "area where damage occurs only to Monsters."

The details of the update are as follows.

■ Update TOPIC
　◆ Monster
　　・We added an area where damage occurs if you stay around the Soul Pot for a certain period of time.
　　　－If you stay within the area, the amount of damage increases over time.
　　　－The amount of damage is reset by leaving the area for a few seconds.

■ Update Details
※Some content may overlap with TOPIC.

　◆New episode
　　・We have implemented the update data for Episode 4.

　◆Gameplay Rebalance
　【Battle Balance】
　　▼Buster
　　　・During battles with COM Monsters, we adjusted the AI of CPU Busters to be stronger than before.

　　▼Monster
　　　・We added an area where you take damage if you continue to stay around the Soul Pot.
　　　・We have changed it so that "Nine-tails" is not invincible while using skills.

　◆System
　　・The interval for switching the stage of Episode Match has been changed from 1 hour to 30 minutes.

　◆Bug Fixes
　　・Fixed a bug where gear customization was not reflected in training.
　　・Fixed a bug where damage was taken even when invincible when falling off the Stage.
　　・Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: 【Announcing Update Version 2.1.0】
notes.content:
[h3]The update to version 2.1.0 will be on July/5 (JST 12:00) for balance adjustment and bug fixes.[/h3]

We are aware of the issue where the game balance becomes significantly skewed under certain tactics,
and plan to implement countermeasures in the next update scheduled for the end of July.

As a temporary measure, we have removed "damage nullification" from the effect of the guard.

If you experience unpleasant behavior while playing the game, please make use of the block and report functions.

Details of the update are as follows.

[h3]◆Gameplay Rebalance[/h3]
[b]【Battle Balance】
▼Monster[/b]
   ・Monsters now recover HP when they prey on Busters.
   ・The "unable to get up" time when "Buddha" collapses has been extended.
   ・The available time to use the skill of "Buddha" has been shortened.
   ・The range of soul purification by "Buddha"'s skill has been narrowed.

[b]▼Undead[/b]
   ・Modified so that "Leech" remains near the ground when it takes damage.

[b]▼Gear[/b]
   ・The recovery amount from the Monster's "HP UP" gear has been halved.

[b]◆Function Adjustment[/b]
   ・Added a menu to make it easier to watch events afterwards
   －You can check from the Story Event in the options

[b]◆Bug Fixes[/b]
   ・Fixed a bug where you fall off the Stage, roll, and fall again.
   ・Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: 【Announcing Update Version 2.0.0】
notes.content:
[h3]We are planning to roll out Ver2.0.0 on June 16 (JST 12:00) for the addition of new features and balance adjustments.[/h3]

In this major update, we aim to improve the aspects that were causing frustration while playing the game, such as "the joy of playing as Monsters," "decreasing the total annihilation rate of Busters," and "enhancing the overall game operability," with an intention to make the game enjoyable regardless of whether you're playing as Busters or Monsters!

The details of the update are as follows.

[h3]■ Update TOPIC[/h3]
　[b]◆ Common Changes[/b]
　・Adjustments have been made to reduce traction on the block and make it easier to move.
　・Both Busters and Monsters have been changed so that they can see each other's name tags. (Visible even through walls)
　・More items were added to score actions during battles, and changes were made so that EXP, Soul Coins, and Soul Gems could be earned in points accordingly.

　[b]◆ Monster[/b]
　・Changed to power-up based on the number of times a Buster is preyed upon and killed.
　　-Powering up makes the Monster's body progressively bigger, and its punches and other judgments become larger, making it easier to destroy blocks and prey on them.
　・The conditions for predation have been changed so that predation occurs when the Buster's HP is reduced to a certain degree and a punch is applied.
　・Changed to blow the Buster farther away immediately after killing the Buster with predation.
　・Changed to prevent Monsters from being mocked by Buster's kicks and punches and obstacles on the stage.
　・The double jump that was possible using walls has been changed to allow triple jumps.

　[b]◆ Buster[/b]
　・Changed when Buster is ghost state, they can be automatically revived over time.
　　-However, the time required for automatic revival increases according to the number of times the ghost state has been ghost state.
　・Changed to when in a ghost state, other Buster can be revived simply by contacting the Buster.
　・Changed it so that you can resurrect from a ghost state when you rescue a Buster who is being preyed upon with a ghost attack.
　・Changed ghost attacks and kicks are slightly homing against Monsters.
　　-When the kick hits the Monster, Monster and Buster behave as if they are bouncing off each other.
　・An alert function has been added whereby the screen frame turns red when a Monster is near itself.

[h3]■ Update Details[/h3]
※Some content may overlap with TOPIC.

　[b]◆New features[/b]
　・A free daily gacha has been added as a login bonus.
　・A stamp board function has been added, where stamps are accumulated according to battle results, coins and gems can be earned and stories can be released.

　・Upon opening the custom screen for the first time after the update, the following weapons will be unlocked and available for use. (If you already possess them, they will be converted to Soul Coins)
　　-Soul Pistol
　　-Soul Shotgun
　　-Soul Laser
　　-Soul Bomb
　　-Soul Machine Gun
　　-Soul Hammer
　　-Soul Bow & Arrow

　[b]◆Gameplay Rebalance[/b]
　【Rewards】
　・More items were added to score actions during battles, and changes were made so that EXP, Soul Coins, and Soul Gems could be earned in points accordingly.

　【Battle Balance】
　・Adjustments have been made to reduce traction on the block and make it easier to move.
　・Soul's contact detection has been increased.
　・Both Busters and Monsters have been changed so that they can see each other's name tags.

　[b]▼Buster[/b]
　・Changed when Buster is ghost state, they can be automatically revived over time.
　　-However, the time required for automatic revival increases according to the number of times the ghost state has been ghost state.
　・Changed to when in a ghost state, other Buster can be revived simply by contacting the Buster.
　・changed it so that you can resurrect from a ghost state when you rescue a Buster who is being preyed upon with a ghost attack.
　・Changed ghost attacks and kicks are slightly homing against Monsters.
　　-When the kick hits the Monster, Monster and Buster behave as if they are bouncing off each other.
　・Reduced stuck time after ghost attacks.
　・An alert function has been added whereby the screen frame turns red when a Monster is near itself.
　・The long press and hold recovery guard button has been removed and changed so that putting souls into the soul pot can recover all HP.
　・When approaching the undead, they are now automatically locked on when shot with Weapons. (Excluding some Weapons)
　・Adjusted to make it easier to get up when tripping over obstacles.
　・The cool time between defeating undead and the appearance of the soul has been removed.
　・Changed so that when a Monster's predation is cancelled, it becomes invincible for a certain period of time.
　・UI additions have been made to make it easier to locate souls and undead.
　・Adjusted the initial position of the Buster in all stages.

　[b]▼Monster[/b]
　・Changed to power-up based on the number of times a Buster is preyed upon and killed.
　　-Powering up makes the Monster's body progressively bigger, and its punches and other judgments become larger, making it easier to destroy blocks and prey on them.
　・The conditions for predation have been changed so that predation occurs when the Buster's HP is reduced to a certain degree and a punch is applied.
　・Changed to blow the buster farther away immediately after killing the Buster with predation.
　・Changed to prevent Monsters from being mocked by Buster's kicks and punches and obstacles on the stage.
　・The double jump that was possible using walls has been changed to allow triple jumps.
　・Monster appearance locations fixed around soul pots.
　・Changed the Monster cannot move for the first three seconds after the battle starts.
　・The behaviour of punches alternating left and right has been changed.
　・Adjusted to make it easier for punches to hit.
　・Changed so that when an undead predator is preyed upon, the predation is automatically cancelled after a few seconds.
　・Heavier action during predation.

　[b]▼Skills[/b]
　　●Kigurumee
　　・Changed "One-Shot Predation" is also performed when a punch released while activating a skill hits a Buster.
　　●Minotaur
　　・Reduced skill damage.
　　・Adjustments to skill easier to hit Busters.
　　・Changed the rush stops when the skill hits the Buster.
　　・Changed when a skill hits a Buster, Buster is flown upwards while spinning.
　　・Reduced trapping on blocks during skill activation.
　　●Oculus
　　・Changed to becomes invincible while activating a skill.
　　・Skills adjusted to make it harder to hit obstacles.
　　・A weak lock-on element has been added to the skill.
　　●Pumpkin
　　・A weak lock-on element has been added to the skill.
　　・The skill penetrates the block and explodes when it hits the ground.
　　　-Touchable destructible blocks are destroyed and indestructible objects are penetrated but remain intact.
　　●Death
　　・The skill has been changed from a specification that generates a circle range in front of itself to a specification that sets up a circle around itself.The skill has been changed from a specification that generates a circle range in front of itself to a specification that sets up a circle around itself.
　　・Extended skill range.
　　●Voodoo Doll
　　・After activating a skill, the skill gauge is reduced even when the beam is not being fired.
　　・The skill has been changed from manually firing the beam to automatically firing the beam when the Buster is within range once activated.
　　　-If Voodoo Doll is out of range, only an effect will appear around the Voodoo Doll's body.
　　・Shortened range of skills.
　　●Mythical Dragon
　　・The skill has been changed from manually firing a flaming breath to a bullet-based system that fires three flaming breaths.
　　・Reduced damage to the main body of the flame breath.
　　・Burn damage caused by skills can now be guarded against.
　　・The duration of burns caused by skills has been extended to around 15 seconds.
　　●Baby-Face
　　・Increased movement speed while activating skills.
　　●Balloon
　　・The skill has been changed from a manual throw specification to one that automatically drops a bomb at your feet after activation.
　　　-The ability to move freely in the air after activation is retained.
　[b]▼Weapons[/b]
　　・Added "Aim Assist" to the "Shooter" series, making it easier to hit.
　　・Adjusted the "Candy Shooter"'s "power" slightly higher and "movement speed during shots" slightly slower.
　　・Increased the "power" of the "Bandead Shooter" and made "movement speed during shots" slower.
　　・Added "Aim Assist" to the "Pistol" series, making it easier to hit.
　　・Extended the "range" of the "Pistol" series.
　　・Slightly extended the "range" and slightly increased the "power" of the "Tiger Attack".
　　　-The "knockback" is slightly larger and the "cool time" is slightly longer.
　　・Extended the "range" and increased the "power" of the "Purple Line".
　　　-The "knockback" is larger and the "cool time" is longer.
　　・Shortened the "range" and lowered the "power" of the "Monster Eyes" and "microSD 256GB Revision", and made it to automatically continue shooting while holding down the button.
　　・Reduced the "knockback" of the "Shotgun" series.
　　・Removed the additional effect of "block destruction" from the "Shotgun" series.
　　・Slightly increased the "power" of the "Honeycomb Compressor".
　　・Increased the "power" of the "Monster Fang".
　　・Lowered the "power" and shortened the "cool time" of the "Giraffe Charge".
　　・For the "Laser" series, we adjusted the thickness of the laser effect based on "power".
　　　- The larger the "power", the thicker the laser effect.
　　・Slightly increased the "knockback" and "power" of the "Green Juice Laser", and made the "action during shot" slightly heavier.
　　・Increased the "knockback" and "power" of the "Blood Laser", and made the "action during shot" impossible.
　　・Added an effect to the "Blood Laser" that allows "block destruction" by continuously hitting the laser.
　　・Shortened the "range" and lowered the "power" of the "Holstein Laser", "Future Spectrum", "DriverPro 20 Revision", and "Cream Ramune Laser".
　　・Changed the "Machine Gun" series from charge type to a specification that fires a certain number of bullets while pressing the button.
　　　- The longer you press, the more bullets you fire, but there is a limit to the number of bullets in one shot.
　　・Added the additional effect of "block destruction" to the "Machine Gun" series.
　　　- The "Bone Crusher" has slightly more "shot bullets" and the "action during shot" is slightly heavier.
　　　- The "cool time" is slightly longer.
　　・The "Diamond Smasher" has many "shot bullets" and the "action during shot" is heavy.
　　　- The "cool time" is longer.
　　・Slightly increased the "power" of the "Steampunk Bomb" and made the "knockback" slightly larger.
　　　- The "cool time" is slightly longer.
　　・Changed the "Mine" series to a specification that automatically explodes if there is no contact for 2 seconds.
　　・Changed the "Hammer" series to charge type.
　　　- The action during charging is heavy.
　　・Changed the "Soul Hammer" to a specification that enlarges the "shot range" when fully charged.
　　・Changed the "Cobra Shock" to a specification that "fires continuously" when fully charged.
　　・Changed the "Monster Punch" to a specification that causes an "explosion" when fully charged.
　　・Added "Aim Assist" to the "Arrow" series, making it easier to hit (excluding some arrows).
　　・Changed the "Arrow" series to charge type.
　　　- The action during charging is not heavy.
　　・Changed the "Soul Arrow" and "Arrow Neg" to a specification that "fires continuously" when fully charged.
　　・Changed the "Hawk Eye" to a specification that increases the "power" when fully charged.
　　・Lowered the "healing power" of the "Soul Healer".

　[b]▼Gear[/b]
　　・Changed the number of Soul Gems required for the initial purchase of gear from 10 to 5.
　　・Changed the Buster's "Guard Recovery Amount Up" to "Soul in Max HP UP".
　　・Changed the effect of the Buster's "Search Ability Up" from "the range where you can see the Undead's HP bar is expanded" to "the range where you can see the Undead icon is expanded".
　　・Changed the Monster's "Guard Recovery Amount Up" to "HP Auto Recovery".
　　・Changed the Monster's "Search Ability Up" to "Undead's HP UP".

　[b]▼Stages[/b]
　　・Adjusted the "Oriental Temple" to make it easier to ride on the lotus.
　　・Adjusted the "Oriental Temple" to make it harder to get caught on the lanterns.

　[b]◆System[/b]
　　・Refurbished the key configuration and made it possible to choose from three types of operation types.
　　・Anemone, Slug, Orca, and Clione can now be selected in party play even if they are not owned.
　　・Changed the stage switching time in Episode Match from 2 hours to 1 hour.
　　・Reorganized the "Weapon" custom page to reduce the number of categories.
　　　- The "Mine" series has moved to the "Bomb" page, and the "Healer" series has moved to the "Other" page.

　[b]◆Bug Fixes
[/b]　　・Also fixed minor bugs.

notes.title: Announcing Update Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
The update to version 1.2.0 will be released on January /26 (12:00 JST) and will include bug fixes, and game balance adjustments.

The details of the update are as follows.

◆Improving Matchmaking
・Busters can keep their teammates to the next match by selecting ""Continue"" together when a match is over.
・It is now possible to match without a Monster player, which makes it possible to find a game with Buster players only. (Previously, you needed at least 1 Buster and 1 Monster player to start a match.)
・Matchmaking scale adjustment
　└ Players in the low-rate tier will be matched with similarly skilled players more often, and players in the high-rate tier match more broadly.


◆Gameplay Rebalance
【Reward】
・Rebalanced to reduce the gap in rewards between Busters and Monsters.
・Some of the requirements to earn exp and Soul coins have been changed.
・Monster's requirement to earn Soul gems has been changed from ""quick annihilation of all Busters"" to ""annihilation of all Busters"".

【Battle balance】
・The amount of ""time it takes for souls to drop"" when you defeat Undead has been reduced.
・The number of button presses required to recover from a fall has been reduced.
・When Monsters cancel Predation, Busters will be shot upwards.

▼Buster
・They can now deal damage against Monster by ghost attack.

▼Monster
・The amount of damage by falling from the stage has been increased.
・Burn damage caused by Mythic Dragon's skill has been reduced while guarding.

▼Undead
・The amount of damage by falling from the stage has been increased.

◆System
・Overall default sound volume has been rebalanced.

◆Bug Fixes
・The issue where cat type items were not set correctly for the requirements to earn the Cat Addict trophy has been fixed.
　－Players who have already achieved the condition will be able to earn the trophy by getting a cat type item again.
　－You can get new cat type items from the new shop in Episode 2, which is coming soon.
　－You will also be able to achieve the trophy by getting the same cat type item that you already have from Soul Gacha.

・The issue of the Crown level up reward containing items you can not receive has been fixed.
　－You can acquire the items by going to the level window while the requirement is achieved.
・The issue where players could get stuck on the roof when returning from falling off the stage on the Nightmare Christmas stage has been fixed.
・The problem of the COM players often getting stuck on obstacles has been fixed.
・The problem of the COM players stopping near souls when the souls are on the water has been fixed.
・And other small fixes.

notes.title: Announcing Update Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone. This will be our first update after the feedback we have received from you. We wanted to thank everyone for your opinions, feedback and patience. More updates will come to improve the game for a better experience and we hope you will stay with us.
The update to version 1.0.2 will be on December/16 (12:00 JST) and will include new features, bug fixes, and game balance adjustments..

The details of the update are as follows.

Regarding global matching, it has been set to not restrict matchmaking.
We will continue to make quick adjustments and updates to the matchmaking system as we view the system and receive feedback from the players.

◆New Content
“Training” mode has been added.
　You can join from the Training in the lower right corner of the main menu.
　You can play CPU matches with the character and equipment selected on the Custom screen.
　Levels and ratings will not be affected.

◆Game Balance
[Rewards]
- When a player is eliminated from an Episode Match, they can earn some EXP as a reward.

[Balancing Battles]
- The "time until Souls appear" when an undead is defeated has been shortened.
- The "time of inactivity after falling" from the stage has been lengthened.
- When the Buster attacks a Monster, the Monster's HP bar and mini-map will be visible to all Busters for a certain period of time.
- The "movement speed" on uphill slopes is slower.
- The mini-map has been updated to show terrain and undead spawning locations.

▼ Buster
- The invincibility time after reviving from a ghost is longer.
- When a "ghost" player falls off the map, they will drop their Souls and return to the map in a tripped state.
- The "knockback" of the「shotgun」and「pistol」has been adjusted.
- The "minimum damage" of the「shotgun」has been increased.
- 「Shotgun」at close range have been made easier to hit.
- The bullets of the "Pistol" have been adjusted to hit easier.
- Healer's healing amount has been reduced.
- Healer damage has been increased.
- The "fire rate" of the "Healer" has decreased.


▼ Monster
- "Faster skill cooldown" near the end of battle is now weaker.
- Increased the size of the "Predation range".
- Predation is now quicker after the button is pressed.
- The "time to complete Predation" for "Kigurumee" skill has been lengthened.
- The behavior of the skills for "Oculus" and "Sakanamon" has been changed.
- The duration of burn caused by the Mythical Dragon skill has been lengthened.
- Reduced the amount of burn damage caused by the Dragon Head skill.

▼ Undead
- The "shield defense range" for "Cuttle" has been reduced.

[Stage/Map]
- The "Soul Pot" has been adjusted for less collision with the player.
- The number of "trippable objects" in the "Deep Forest" has been reduced.
- When colliding with trippable objects in succession, the player will not trip over until the player is away from the trippable objects for a certain range.
- Fixed the "fence collision" to be only during jumping.

◆Other Adjustments
- Improved the matchmaking for Episode Matches.
- In Episode Matches, the winning player can no longer punch, kick, or activate shots/skills during the results.
- In Episode Matches, when a player enters the match as a buster, matchmaking will be stopped when the player is close to winning.
- The volume of "ZITABATA" of SAKANAMON collaboration music has been lowered.

◆Bug fixes
- Fixed an issue that prevented keyboard/mouse control on the Steam version.
　When any key or button is pressed on the title screen, it will be recognized as "keyboard/mouse" or "gamepad".
- Fixed a problem in which the game did respond properly after key configuration.
- Fixed an issue that caused an error when matchmaking in Episode Matches on the PS5 version.
- Fixed an issue that caused some Monsters' rapid ranged skills to become more powerful with button mashing.
- Fixed an issue that caused Monsters to continue Predation on busters when they were in a ghost state.
- Fixed an issue that caused Souls to drop on blocks with trippable objects such as fences, stones, and tree roots.
- Fixed an issue that prevented players from acquiring Souls, even if they did not have any Souls, when multiple Souls were present.
- Fixed an issue that caused the camera to be inverted.
- Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: New patch coming soon for bug fixes and game balance adjustment
notes.content:
Thank you for playing and supporting "Goonya Monster".

We are getting many reports of problems and requests after the game has been released.
We apologize again for the inconvenience caused by those issues.

We are reading all of the messages from you. We are going to do our best to improve the game to deliver a more fun experience with Goonya Monster.

We would like to announce that there is a patch scheduled to be released soon.
The patch will fix the following issues and balance adjustment  below and many more.

・The bug that prevents keyboard/mouse operation on the Steam platform will be fixed.
→The game will automatically set the control mode to mouse and keyboard or gamepad depending on which interface you use on the title screen.

・The bug that causes an error when matching in Episode Match.

We are also testing the global matching feature as well.

We will continue to develop "Goonya Monster" to improve more based on the feedback we receive.
We are planning to continue to have other events for everyone's enjoyment in the future. Please stay tuned.

Thank you for your continuing support for Goonya Monster.

notes.title: Update for the reported issue of the Digital DX edition bonus
notes.content:
For those who bought the Digital DX edition,

The reported problem that players could not get the bonus of Soul Coins and Soul Gems even though they bought the Digital DX edition has been fixed.

We are ready to send you the rewards.
But the instructions will be different depending on when you bought the DX edition.
Please check when you bought it and follow the right instruction below to receive them.

〇Bought the DX edition before December 6th（9:00 AM JST）
1. Open the detail page of the bundle from the link below
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28805/_DX/
2. Click on 「Add to Account」 button on the lower part of the page with bundle information
3. Launch Goonya Monster from Steam
4. A notification will show up in the main menu and you will automatically receive the items

〇Bought the DX edition after December 6th（9:00 AM JST）
1. Launch the game from Steam after December 12 (9:00 AM JST)
2. A notification will show up in the main menu and you will automatically receive the items


We apologize for the delay in fixing the issue and any inconvenience it caused.
Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Future plans to resolve issues that have arisen
notes.content:
The development team is working to correct the following phenomena that are currently occurring
1: Some of the Steam version DX edition benefits are not included.
2: The keyboard and mouse do not respond in some environments in the Steam version.
3: Network errors sometimes occur in the matching process.

The first issue is scheduled to be distributed on December 6 (9:00 JST) and is being coordinated.
The patches to fix 2 and 3 will be released on December 20 (JST).


In addition, we are still investigating the cause of the following phenomena.
- Graphics card dependent glitches that render gameplay impossible.

We are aware of all the feedback we receive through social networking sites and the community.
We are working hard to improve the playing environment, not only with patches, but also with overall game balance adjustments.
We will make every effort to improve the game play environment.

Since the release of the game, we have received more feedback from many people than we had expected, and the entire staff is very proud of the response.
There may be many things we haven't done well, but we will continue to strive for a better experience for everyone.

Thank you for your continued support of Goonya Monster.
